scripts.dev: npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace @council/web && npm run dev --workspace @council/infra
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace @council/web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tooling/infra && tsc --noEmit -p apps/extension && npm run typecheck --workspace @council/livefact-youtube
scripts.lint: oxlint apps packages tooling && oxfmt --check apps packages tooling package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: oxfmt apps packages tooling package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace @council/web && npm run deploy:dev --workspace @council/infra
scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace @council/extension && npm run build --workspace @council/livefact-youtube && node tools/publish-extension.mjs
